name: yf_upgrades_downgrades
description:
Analyst rating changes for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance upgrades_downgrades), the 30 most recent.
Returns: {symbol, upgrades_downgrades: [{GradeDate, Firm, ToGrade, FromGrade, Action (up, down, main, init, reit), priceTargetAction, currentPriceTarget, priorPriceTarget}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Aggregate counts: yf_recommendations; target summary: yf_analyst_price_targets. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
